text: Supports request-level variables that can be reused within a single request
quote: Request variables.

text: Revamped OAuth 2.0 support with multiple grant types for authenticating requests

text: Supports OIDC-based single sign-on

text: Headers or auth set on a collection automatically apply to all requests inside it
quote: When you add a header or auth to a collection, it will be applied to all requests in that collection.

text: Can embed a mini interactive version of Hoppscotch into any HTML page

text: Runs directly in the browser with no installation needed

text: Can import requests directly from a pasted cURL command
